title.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件索引（社区托管）

description.en: Official @deepseek-ai plugin packages for DeepSeek Harness, listed by an independent community index.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 官方 @deepseek-ai 插件包，由独立社区索引收录。

description.en: Experimental profile bundle enabling Agent Teams over dsh-base.
description.zh: 实验性 bundle：在 dsh-base 上启用 Agent Teams 多智能体团队协作。

description.en: Per-tool LLM authorization review for the Auto permission preset.
description.zh: 为 Auto 权限预设提供逐工具 LLM 授权审查。

description.en: Offer the powered-by-DSH badge as a discoverable skill.
description.zh: 把 powered-by-DSH 徽章作为可发现的技能提供。

description.en: Experimental machine translation of expanded reasoning.
description.zh: 实验性：对展开的推理（CoT）做机器翻译。

description.en: Optional Web bundle for raw Session logs and Chat node inspection.
description.zh: 可选 Web bundle：查看原始会话日志与 Chat 节点。

description.en: Experimental custom plugin markets: a Discover tab that browses and installs bundles from plugin market indexes.
description.zh: 实验性自定义插件市场：Discover 标签页，浏览并安装索引源中的 bundle。

description.en: Run explicitly requested repeated work with fresh agents.
description.zh: 用全新 agent 循环执行明确要求的重复工作。

description.en: Give Agents tools to search and read earlier sessions from the current workspace.
description.zh: 给 Agent 提供搜索和读取当前工作区历史会话的工具。

description.en: Refresh session titles as new human prompts arrive.
description.zh: 新消息到来时自动刷新会话标题。

description.en: Keep shell processes alive across tool calls.
description.zh: 让 shell 进程跨工具调用保持存活。

description.en: Model tool that creates and enters a new Git worktree.
description.zh: 模型工具：创建并进入新的 Git worktree。

description.en: Experimental voice input with local SenseVoice; downloads its runtime on first use.
description.zh: 实验性语音输入（本地 SenseVoice），首次使用时下载运行时。

description.en: One-shot Claude Code subagent provider over the official Agent SDK.
description.zh: 通过官方 Agent SDK 调用一次性 Claude Code 子代理。

description.en: One-shot Codex subagent provider over the official app-server protocol.
description.zh: 通过官方 app-server 协议调用一次性 Codex 子代理。

description.en: Model-facing subagent delegation tool over the ctx.subagents seam.
description.zh: 面向模型、基于 ctx.subagents 的子代理委派工具。
